protocol.metric: Binary anomaly-class Average Precision; pos_label=1; continuous log-odds; percentage in reports

profiles.F1_epoch_default: Raw graph-specific default evaluator params; validation macro-F1 chooses epoch; AP is diagnostic on the chosen model.
profiles.AP_epoch_HPO12: 12 predefined shared GCN settings; 3 validation seeds on highest-rate seed-1 graph; validation AP selects both epoch and configuration; freeze before final test evaluation.

protocol.selection: Highest mean validation AP; ties use lowest candidate ID
protocol.final_seeds: Preserve each input graph original ten evaluation seeds; pool all declared reduction seeds.
protocol.source: One common frozen evaluation package (same as the completed extra-cell/GDEM HPO batch); original graph source identities retained per record.
protocol.graph_selection: Existing graphs retained as frozen inputs. Graph generation and historical macro-F1-based reduction checkpoint selection are NOT redone. This is a retrospective downstream-AP extension, not a wholly new AP-optimal benchmark.
protocol.budget: Whole is an unreduced control; TSpanner is an edge-reduction control retaining all train nodes. They are not node-budget competitors.
protocol.test_policy: All 12 AP validation candidates complete and selection frozen before either final test profile is evaluated; no test-selected configuration or threshold.
protocol.comparison: Compare AP to constant-score prevalence baseline and to Averaging. Macro-F1 and AP magnitudes are not improvements of the same metric.
